{{Quote|The transmission has been cut off, sir. I think the general did it himself.|The droid speaking to Count Dooku|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] was defeated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] ended a transmission with Count Dooku regarding the ship's fate, this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] informed Dooku that Grievous had ended the transmission himself.
